aboutDirection.title: The JET Information Security Center employs over 300 specialists and has completed dozens of secure projects in the public sector, banking, and industry. We design information security architectures, build processes, implement SIEM, DLP, IDM, and PAM solutions, conduct penetration tests, and train teams.

aboutVacancy.title: What will be included in your responsibilities
aboutVacancy.description: You will participate in the development of IS solution architecture, assist in risk assessment, design protection systems, participate in technical presales, and support the implementation of solutions at customers

items.title: We expect you to
Experience in system integration in the field of information security for at least 6 years

Knowledge of the main regulatory requirements of Federal legislation and regulators in the field of information protection, including regulatory legal acts of FSTEC of Russia and FSB of Russia, 149-FZ, 152-FZ, 187-FZ, FSTEC Orders 17, 21, 239, 31, FSB Order 378

Experience in forming information security threat models (understanding current threats, knowledge of the regulatory framework of domestic regulators in terms of threat analysis, justification of threat mitigation by organizational and technical measures)
Experience in sizing, planning installation, deployment, maintenance, and performance tuning of server and network equipment, Windows, Linux, and any other OS (Solaris, AIX, xBSD)

Knowledge and practical experience in applying open-source technologies and products in production environments to ensure fault tolerance, backup, monitoring, proxying, and containerization of application solutions, as well as automation of typical operations.

Knowledge of products in at least 2 areas of information security (WAF, PAM, access control systems, virtualization environment protection, vulnerability management, EDR, SIEM/IRP/SOAR/sGRC, NGFW) at the architect level
Experience in designing and applying built-in protection mechanisms of IT solutions (OS, DBMS, virtualization, network equipment)
Understanding the principles of creating information protection systems, industry standards, main processes, and approaches to the development of information security in organizations
Experience in implementing technologically complex (in terms of functionality and/or architecture) projects in the role of chief designer or architect
Broad outlook, awareness of modern containerization, automation, monitoring, application development, and delivery technologies

Experience in implementing complex projects involving interaction with multiple customer departments, skills in technical negotiations, presenting the position and solution of the Contractor, as well as analyzing the business needs of the Customer
Interest in optimizing design solutions and the technological sequence of work on the project, functional leadership in project teams (as chief designer), and the development of team members
Knowledge of English at a level necessary for oral communication with Vendor representatives
Higher technical education
What tasks await you
Participation in the development of architectural solutions and technical proposals for network information security subsystems
Control of Customer satisfaction with the progress and results of the project, management of Customer expectations
Development and coordination with the Customer of the architecture of the technical solution implementing the technical tasks of the project
Project team management, task delegation, control and acceptance of project team work results, quality control of completed work

Design and implementation of comprehensive information protection systems taking into account both the requirements of RD FSTEC and Russian legislation, as well as best practices for countering cyber threats
Direct participation in project implementation, configuration and testing of implemented information security solutions
Interaction with Vendor specialists in solving technical problems
Demonstration of project results to the customer, conducting PSI, negotiations on the qualification of comments and their elimination within the agreed time frame
Participation in the development of department specialists’ competencies, selection of promising solutions for business development, optimization of production processes
would be a plus
Have at least 6 years of experience in information security
Understand the principles of Zero Trust, RBAC, access management
You know the basic classes of solutions: SIEM, DLP, NGFW
